title: Submodule Advance Record
description: One completed advance (or rejection) of a submodule to its own upstream latest, per spec.md FR-015/FR-016 and data-model.md.

parent_pin_updated.description: MUST be false when outcome is REJECTED_BREAKING_CHANGE or REJECTED_PUSH_CONFLICT (research.md R-005 step 5).

outcome.description: REFUSED_GOVERNANCE_DENY (added 2026-08-21) means the submodule is on the governance deny-list and was never even examined for a newer commit: its pin is governed by a separate, human-driven process, not by this pipeline. It is recorded rather than skipped, because a governance refusal that leaves no evidence is invisible at rest.
